claude_proposed_widenings.name: MagicItemRecord attunement restriction metadata
claude_proposed_widenings.justification: The existing magic-item record can only express a boolean attunement requirement, so it loses the class-gated eligibility on items that require attunement by specific classes.
claude_proposed_widenings.evidence: Staff, Rare (Requires Attunement by a Bard, Cleric, or Druid)
